notes.title: v0.6.6042 Patch note - 4/24/2023
notes.content:
[b][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where you could lose your save file if you logged into steam on a different computer with the same account
[*] Fixed some FPS issues with Stormcaller, still more to fix here but should be much better
[/list]

[b][u]UI Updates[/u][/b]
We have made changes across most of the UI to streamline things and reduce overall clutter. The most significant updates are the Armory screen and In-Game UI.

[b][u]Armory and Late Game Scaling[/u][/b]
Armory kill passive upgrades were scaling much faster than intended when combined with Psion Rank. We have made a few adjustments to make sure that you can still make significant progress increasing your power, but not become so powerful you don't even need to play the game.

To compensate for this shift in power, all Armory Passive (the ones that scaled with kills) no longer require a minimal kill count to activate.

[list]
[*] Total kills are now capped at 1,000,000 for the generic (left side) unlocks
[*] Specialization specific kills are capped at 500,000
[*] Psion Rank 1 gives you double kills but this does not increase after rank 1. The other stats still increase with each rank.
[/list]

[b][u]Val[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] There is now a volume control slider in settings to control the volume of Val. She will still show up but you can silence her or quite her.
[*] You can click Val when she appears to dismiss that message and stop her immediately 
[/list]

notes.title: Launch Day Hotfix
notes.content:
There were a few significant bugs that players reported that we wanted to hotfix as quickly as possible. A few others are still being worked on. We will have other updates in a regular patch later. 

[u]Bug Fixes:[/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Black Blossoms and Eyeless were not properly scaling with game length.[/b] They are now much tougher enemies (as they always were supposed to be). 
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Mortar turret damage fixed. [/b]The biggest impact is on late game scaling. Turrets are meant to supplement your ability damage and effects, not solo the game for you.
[/list]

[u]Known Issues:[/u]
[list]
[*] FPS can drop on Stormcaller with a lot of enemies alive at once. We are investigating this. (It is possible that this can also happen on Electric but it is not confirmed)
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access is Live!
notes.content:
[b]We are thrilled to announce that Hope's End is now officially live in Early Access on Steam![/b]

This is just the start of the journey and we have tons of content we are still working on adding to the game, more details below on that. With this initial release into EA we are hoping to get as much player feedback as possible to make the game great. 

As a team we have a passion for single player games that let you just pick up and play for 20 minutes or 3 hours. We have played our fair share of games with weekly resets and hardcore PVP and they are great, but they aren't the thing that captures our hearts. With Hope's End we are hoping that we capture that feeling of deep progression and skill cap to unlock and chase but balanced with the feeling that it is a game you can pick up AND put down whenever you want without pressure to keep up with everyone else.

Now that EA release is out, please join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/fnvwJ2MJeC]Discord[/url], and give us your feedback. We have a vision for where the game is going, but a major part of that vision is how the community engages with it. As a 3 person team we count on our players to help us see new ideas and ways to improve existing features. This has already been happening with our awesome Beta testers and the game is completely different then it would have been without them.

[h1]Now about that roadmap....[/h1]

First, we have disabled leaderboards for the time being. We didn't have a chance to properly encrypt and secure the save file so we didn't want to encourage shenanigans with hacked high scores out of the gate. We absolutely think that playing the game without hacking your save file is the best experience, but it is a single player game and you can do what you want (don't blame us if you break stuff). But you can see how they can conflict with public leaderboards. Anyways, this is something we will continue to kick around with the community.

[h2]Stormcaller Specialization[/h2]
We were able to fit this into the Early Access build and it is playable now. The first of our second set of 6 Specializations (12 total).

[h2]The Matriarchs & our next Specialization[/h2]
The Matriarchs update will introduce the leaders of the Blighted as boss encounters during a game. Some of them will be spawned with specific triggers that you can control, others will be a bit harder to manage when they show up. When they do show up you will need to focus your attention on bringing them down before they bring complete destruction to the valley and Hope's End. Each will have it's own special mechanics that you will have to learn and deal with. 

We will have more details on the next Specialization in the coming weeks.

[h2]Val Upgrades [/h2]
We fully expect Val to be a character that is both loved and loathed. For us she is the result of countless hours hanging out with Claptrap and GLaDOS and a key part to making Hope's End come alive. The Val update will make her more than just a voice in your head, she will actively be "helping" you in combat. She may malfunction from time to time and be less helpful they she would hope, but with a few upgrades and tweaks we are sure you can make her "useful" and possibly even adjust her sarcasm settings.

[h2]Steam Achievements [/h2]
Yes there will be many Steam Achievements! We will likely add these rather soon, we just wanted things to settle down a bit in the development cycle first so they can be stable and things we keep. 

[h2]New Maps [/h2]
We have a lot of ideas bouncing around for where we go next with maps in Hope's End. This is a topic we will be discussing more with the community on Discord so please join in. The 1.0 release of Hope's End will have multiple maps and mission goals, that much we know for sure. 

Thanks again for giving Hope's End a try and we look forward to seeing your high scores!
